def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def local(path, exists=True):
    path = Path(path)
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts), 'own relative admission path')
    for part in (path, *path.parents):
        if part == Path('.'):
            break
        need(not part.is_symlink() and not (part / '.git').exists(), 'plain own admission boundary before writes')
        if part.exists():
            need(part.stat().st_dev == root.stat().st_dev, 'same-volume admission data')
    if exists:
        need(path.is_file() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), 'complete ordinary admission member')
    return path


def save(name, value):

    need(not path.exists(), 'retain complete first admission source/result: ' + name)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))

def product(name):

    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def identity(path):
    path = local(path)
    before = path.stat()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
            digest.update(chunk)
    after = path.stat()
    need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
         (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'whole admission file epoch conserved')
    return dict(bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(before.st_mode & 0o111))


def programs():
    return {str(path): dict(body=(raw := local(path).read_bytes()).decode(), identity=pin(raw))
            for path in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if path.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}


def fixed_sources(names):
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    result = {}

            need('\n' not in name and ':' not in name and not name.startswith('/'), 'safe complete Git source member')
            process.stdin.write((REVISION + ':' + name + '\n').encode())
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'complete fixed source blob')
            raw = process.stdout.read(int(header[2]))
            need(len(raw) == int(header[2]) and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole source blob body')
            result[name] = raw
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'', 'whole Git source protocol')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    return result


def metrics(sources):

    for name, raw in sources.items():
        lines = raw.split(b'\n')
        widths = [len(line[:-1] if index < len(lines)-1 and line.endswith(b'\r') else line)

        rows[name] = dict(**pin(raw), lines=raw.count(b'\n'), line_bytes=max(widths, default=0))
    return dict(members=rows, metrics=dict(files=len(rows), bytes_total=sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),
        lines_total=sum(r['lines'] for r in rows.values()), bytes_each=max(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),

import os

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
